title: MultiblockCore: Integrations
summary: Support large structures with power, item flow, scans, records, and blueprint checks.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Blockworks helps mark footprints, Logistics stages required blocks, PowerGrid feeds machines, and Index can expose structure or task references.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Blockworks to mark footprints, Logistics to stage blocks, PowerGrid to feed machines, and Index to expose blueprint or task references.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If helpers are missing, keep a flat build pad, count materials before placing, and validate the frame before installing upgrades.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
